_comment: v0.17 L3 FEEL EVIDENCE, NIGHT leg + the reduce-motion control. Same cell and framing as the day/dusk legs. The control shot is taken on the SAME BUILD of the boulevard shot 01 was taken on: reduce-motion is toggled standing on the exterior with no door crossing after it, so 01-vs-03 proves the setting answers LIVE (v0.17 fix wave, finding #3 -- the earlier version of this script crossed a door to force a rebuild, which was the defect's workaround written into the evidence). Row 1 of the boulevard is blocked end to end, so the bump sets facing without moving and the stationer door opens on interact.
Back out through the same door FIRST: the stationer's own exit sits below the arrival cell. Everything after this point happens on one single build of the boulevard.

== REDUCE-MOTION CONTROL, live.
